About · 06

Yuanfei
(Cheyenne) Hu

My path into computational neuroscience began with applied mathematics and an interest in how simple local rules can produce complex, adaptive behaviour.

I now work across modelling, machine learning and neuroscience, with particular attention to explanations that are mechanistically clear and empirically testable.

Outside research, dance, athletics, travel and photography remain important parts of my life. They have shaped my sense of disciplined practice, observation and embodied learning without needing to become research metaphors.

Selected distinctions

Chancellor’s Scholarship, one recipient per cohort · Dean’s List with Distinction, Top 10% · National First-Class Athlete · Royal Academy of Dance A2 Distinction · DKU Athletic Champion, 2022 and 2023
